# Filter the dataframe for the county 'centru'
centru_row = df[df['county'].str.strip().str.lower() == 'centru']

# Check if the row exists
if centru_row.empty:
    answer = False
else:
    # Extract the values for exports and imports in us mil
    # Clean the numeric columns by removing spaces and converting to float
    exports_val_str = centru_row['exports (us mil)'].iloc[0]
    imports_val_str = centru_row['imports (us mil)'].iloc[0]
    
    # Remove any spaces and convert to float
    exports_val = float(str(exports_val_str).replace(' ', '').replace(',', ''))
    imports_val = float(str(imports_val_str).replace(' ', '').replace(',', ''))
    
    # Calculate the total exports and imports across all counties
    total_exports = df['exports (us mil)'].apply(lambda x: float(str(x).replace(' ', '').replace(',', ''))).sum()
    total_imports = df['imports (us mil)'].apply(lambda x: float(str(x).replace(' ', '').replace(',', ''))).sum()
    
    # Calculate the percentage for centru county
    exports_pct = (exports_val / total_exports) * 100
    imports_pct = (imports_val / total_imports) * 100
    
    # Compare with the claimed values (13.8% and 11.2%)
    answer = (abs(exports_pct - 13.8) < 0.01) and (abs(imports_pct - 11.2) < 0.01)
